articles.title: Adobe is testing how well AI agents can use editing tools like a Photoshop professional would
articles.summary: Adobe Research and UC San Diego built EditAgent, an AI system that edits images more like a Photoshop pro. Instead of retrying the same general-purpose editor over and over, the agent picks the right specialized tool for each task and lets a standard language model choose the best result based on measured image data.
